description: Read source-cited context from an ingested board snapshot. Start overviews, summaries and documentation with a call without topic, nodeIds, limit and maxChars: its first page names the largest sections and lists sections with IDs. Then pass section, page, frame or group IDs as nodeIds; several IDs share each page in request order. For a whole-board summary, pass all top-level section IDs (at most 50 per call) with maxChars 24000, follow nextCursor, then read outsideSections: true. Default detail: "auto" switches reads of multiple distinct IDs or one page, section, frame or group to a compact overview only when the first full page would leave unread excerpts. Overview lines contain node IDs and deterministically shortened text (50–120 characters); structuredContent puts the excerpts once in overview.text, with empty evidence and clusters. limit applies only to the full view and is ignored in an overview, even when explicit. Read the complete source and Figma link with the same boardId and snapshotId, nodeIds: ["<ID>"] and detail: "full"; table IDs read every row. Without overview, excerpts are in evidence. Read outsideSections: true, search with topic, or continue with cursor. Cite the node ID or Figma link behind each statement. Synthesize the answer yourself. No network or LLM calls; use ingest_board to refresh Figma content.

boardId.description: The Figma file key returned by ingest_board, or the board URL. A URL with a node-id, without nodeIds, topic and outsideSections, reads that node

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, unchanged; send it with the same topic, nodeIds, outsideSections, detail, limit and maxChars

detail.description: auto uses a compact, source-marked overview when a requested container or several nodeIds need multiple full pages; full returns linked evidence objects. Overview lines may be shortened; use full to read all text

limit.description: Maximum evidence excerpts per full page (default 20, at most 100); ignored in an automatic overview, even when explicit. Use detail: full for an excerpt limit

maxChars.description: Character budget for each representation: the readable text content and the JSON of structuredContent (default 12000, minimum 2000)

nodeIds.description: Read exact source nodes, all rows of a table or the row of a table cell, or every excerpt inside a page, section, frame or group by its ID (nested sections included, in reading order); several IDs in one call share every page in request order; cannot be combined with topic

outsideSections.description: Read every excerpt that lies in no section, cluster by cluster in reading order, tables row by row; on a board without sections, all excerpts. Cannot be combined with topic or nodeIds

snapshotId.description: Read a specific retained snapshot instead of the latest board

topic.description: Words to search for. An excerpt matches when at least one of them is in its text, its section or node name, the label of an arrow attached to it or, for a table row, its column headings, as a whole word ignoring case and accents (words of five or more letters also match compounds that begin with them); excerpts with more of the words come first. Other word forms, synonyms and translations do not match: include them yourself, for example "payment payments pay Bezahlung". Cannot be combined with nodeIds or outsideSections.

name: get_board_context

frameNames.description: Named enclosing frames and groups, outermost first; excerpts repeat them only where they differ

modelDerived.description: True for model summaries and summaries whose non-model origin cannot be established

pageName.description: Page of this cluster's excerpts on this page of results; excerpts repeat it only where they differ

sectionNames.description: Enclosing sections, outermost first, of this cluster's excerpts; excerpts repeat them only where they differ

sourceNodeIds.description: Source nodes displayed on this page, not citations validating the cluster summary

summary.description: Model summary of the cluster; empty for deterministic clusters, whose excerpts carry the text, and where maxChars leaves no room for it

summarySource.description: Origin of the derived cluster summary; the summary is not verbatim source evidence

connections.description: Arrows with at least one end, or a section, frame or group around one, among this page's excerpts; never arrows to a page. The label is the text on the arrow

fromText.description: Short text or name of the start node when it is not among this page's excerpts, redacted like excerpts

toText.description: Short text or name of the end node when it is not among this page's excerpts, redacted like excerpts

contextText.description: Orientation and reading instructions. Excerpts are in overview.text when overview is present (evidence and clusters are then empty), otherwise in evidence; text content carries the same readable excerpts

evidence.description: Full linked excerpts; empty in overview mode, where excerpts are in overview.text instead

frameNames.description: Named enclosing frames and groups, outermost first; included only when nonempty and different from the cluster

modelDerived.description: Absent means false, independent of the cluster's modelDerived

pageName.description: Only for an excerpt outside the listed clusters or whose location differs from its cluster's

sectionNames.description: Same rule as pageName; an empty list means outside sections

snapshotId.description: Omitted when inherited from the response snapshotId; only snapshotId is inherited

truncated.description: Absent means false, independent of the cluster

ignoredArguments.description: Unknown input keys that were ignored; their values are not echoed. Absent when none

overview.description: Present only for automatic compact overview pages; evidence and clusters are empty, not a claim of no matches. Read a line's full text and Figma link with the same boardId and snapshotId, its nodeId, and detail: full

text.description: Source-marked excerpt lines grouped by innermost section; the excerpt texts occur only here in structuredContent

relations.description: Cluster-to-cluster relations derived from connector arrows

label.description: Connector label(s), when the arrows are annotated

truncation.description: Explicit omissions from structured results and the readable text

omittedSummaries.description: Clusters on this page whose model summary is left empty to fit maxChars

unknownNodeIds.description: Requested nodeIds that are not in this snapshot; the others are read

title: Get Board Context
